req.title: Deleting all tasks leaves empty table
req.statement: The system shall leave GET /tasks/ returning [] after every task has been deleted.
triggers: deleting all tasks leaves empty table

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that after all tasks are deleted, a GET request to /tasks/ should return an empty list. This behavior needs to be verified through positive, negative, and boundary test cases to ensure robustness against common mutations.

tests.name: test_delete_all_tasks_positive
preconditions: The tasks table is initially empty.
expected: The GET request returns an empty list.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

# Create two tasks
response1 = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Task 1", "description": "Description 1", "completed": False})
assert response1.status_code == 201
response2 = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Task 2", "description": "Description 2", "completed": False})
assert response2.status_code == 201

# Delete both tasks
client.delete(f"/tasks/{response1.json()['id']}")
client.delete(f"/tasks/{response2.json()['id']}")

# Verify that GET /tasks/ returns an empty list
response = client.get("/tasks/")
assert response.status_code == 200
assert response.json() == []

tests.name: test_delete_nonexistent_task_negative
preconditions: The tasks table is initially empty.
actions: Attempt to delete a task with a non-existent ID.
expected: The DELETE request returns a 404 status code.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

# Attempt to delete a non-existent task
response = client.delete("/tasks/999")
assert response.status_code == 404
assert response.json()["detail"] == "Task with id 999 not found"

tests.name: test_delete_task_boundary
preconditions: The tasks table is initially empty.
expected: The GET request returns an empty list.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

# Create a single task
response = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Boundary Task", "description": "Boundary Description", "completed": False})
assert response.status_code == 201

# Delete the task
client.delete(f"/tasks/{response.json()['id']}")

# Verify that GET /tasks/ returns an empty list
response = client.get("/tasks/")
assert response.status_code == 200
assert response.json() == []
